This project showcases a responsive pricing table implemented using HTML and CSS. It demonstrates modern web design principles including flexbox layout, responsive design, and CSS transitions.

Key Features:
- Responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes
- Clean and attractive UI for displaying pricing tiers
- Use of flexbox for layout
- CSS transitions for interactive elements
- Custom color scheme and typography
- CSS reset for consistent styling across browsers

The project consists of two main files:
1. index.html: Contains the structure of the pricing table
2. app.css: Provides all the styling, including the responsive design

This project is suitable for intermediate web developers looking to practice HTML structure and CSS styling techniques. It's an excellent example of how to create a common web component that could be integrated into larger projects.

Note: This is a front-end only implementation. Backend integration for processing sign-ups or free trials is not included.

Tags: HTML, CSS, Responsive Design, Flexbox, Web Component, Pricing Table

File: WebsiteBlocker.py

Description:
This repository contains a Python script that implements a website blocker to enhance productivity during working hours. The script automatically blocks access to specified websites during a defined time period and unblocks them outside of that period.

Features:
•Blocks specified websites during working hours (default: 8 AM to 4 PM)
•Automatically unblocks websites during non-working hours
•Configurable list of websites to block
•Works on Windows (path can be adjusted for Mac and Linux)
•Runs continuously, checking time every 5 seconds

How it works:
1. The script modifies the system's hosts file to redirect specified websites to localhost (127.0.0.1) during working hours.
2. Outside working hours, it removes these modifications, allowing normal access to the websites.

Usage:
•Ensure you have necessary permissions to modify the hosts file
•Run the script with administrative privileges
• Customize the website_list variable to include the websites you want to block
•Adjust the working hours in the time condition if needed

Note: This script is designed to run continuously. For production use, consider implementing it as a system service or scheduled task.

Requirements:
•Python 3.x
•Administrative privileges (to modify the hosts file)

Disclaimer:
This script modifies system files. Use with caution and at your own risk. Ensure you understand the implications before running it on your system.

Files:
1. map1.py: Python script to generate the interactive map
2. my_map.html: Generated HTML file containing the interactive map
3. Volcanoes_USA.csv: CSV file with data on USA volcanoes
4. world.json: GeoJSON file with world population data

Description:
This repository contains a Python project that creates an interactive web map using Folium. The map displays two main features:
1.Volcanoes in the USA: Represented by circle markers with colors indicating their elevations.
2. World Population Data: Countries are color-coded based on population ranges.

The main Python script (map1.py) reads data from the CSV and GeoJSON files to create the map, which is then saved as an HTML file (my_map.html) for easy viewing in a web browser.

Features:
• Interactive map with zoom and pan capabilities
• Color-coded volcano markers based on elevation
•Population data visualization for countries worldwide
•Layered design allowing users to toggle between different data views

Data Sources:
• Volcanoes_USA.csv: Contains information about volcanoes in the USA, including their locations and elevations
• world.json: GeoJSON file with world population data

To use this project:
1. Ensure you have Python and the required libraries (particularly Folium) installed
2. Run the map1.py script to generate the map
2. Open my_map.html in a web browser to view the interactive map

This project serves as an excellent example of data visualization using Python and web technologies, combining geographical and population data into an easy-to-understand interactive format.
Contributions, issue reports, and suggestions for improvements are welcome to enhance this geographical data visualization tool.
